scenario: Scenario 9: Student Switch (A -> B -> A) & Race Condition Handling with Out-of-Order Responses
verificationLevel: Android GUI Runtime (Pixel 8 Emulator, WHPX, Android 16)
backendMode: Spring Boot Modular Monolith (dev profile, port 8082)

requestsTimeline.action: Request A1 intercepted and HELD by proxy
Request B intercepted and HELD by proxy
Request A2 intercepted and HELD by proxy
Delivered response A2 to client first
Delivered late response A1 to client (must be discarded by activeRequestIdRef)
Delivered late response B to client (must be discarded by currentStudentIdRef)
Delivered 500 rejection for B2; cleanly discarded by client without error banner

invariantsVerified: 1. Request cancellation via AbortController on studentId change
2. Monotonic activeRequestId sequence tracking (guards against A -> B -> A)
3. Out-of-order resolution protection: late response A1 cannot overwrite A2
4. Student identity isolation: late response B cannot leak confidential data to Student A
5. Late rejection tolerance: delayed errors from prior requests do not trigger false error banners
6. Preservation of date range, timezone and metricScope without mixing across students
